summary:
- Document No: 4521-CAL-AEE-75-52-0003-GAR for Job No.: Drain back tank support Project: Solana Generating Station.
- Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle allows for non-standard billing cycles upon request.
- Confidential information must not be reproduced without permission from ABENER TEYMA SOLANA.
- Revisions include updating IBC reference to IBC 2012 and other minor updates.
- Table of Contents outlines sections on Overview, Description, Codes and Normative, Design Basis, Results, Load Combinations, Calculation Report, and Anchor Bolt Checking.
- Drain Back tank support designed for Solana Generating Station.
- Support composed of steel profiles and anchored by post-installed bolts.
- Design based on static finite elements analysis using shell elements.
- Materials include structural steel W-shape (ASTM A992) and other structural steel (ASTM A36).
- Safety factors and load combination coefficients according to ANSI/AISC 360-05 (LRFD).
- Dead load includes self-weight of steel elements, drain tank, and pump.
- Live load is weight water in maximum capacity of the tank.
